dialogs.about: 딸이 들러 요즘 다니는 운동 교실 이야기를 나눠요

lines.en: Mom, how often do you go to the class?
lines.ko: 엄마, 그 교실에 얼마나 자주 가세요?

lines.en: Twice a week. I go on quiet mornings.
lines.ko: 일주일에 두 번요. 조용한 아침에 가요.

lines.en: Do you ever feel tired after the class?
Not really. I seldom feel tired now.
Does your friend still go with you?
Occasionally. But she calls me frequently.
I visited your class once last month.
lines.ko: 지난달에 엄마 교실에 한 번 갔어요.

lines.en: I know. Whenever you come, everyone smiles.
lines.ko: 알아요. 딸이 올 때마다 다들 웃어요.

lines.en: Then I will come every month.
Thank you. I will save a seat.
Excuse me. Do you have a reading club?
Yes. It is a weekly club.
Can anyone come to it?
Of course. We rarely say no to anyone.
Do you have an art class too?
Yes, a monthly one. It starts at ten.
lines.ko: 네, 매달 한 번 열려요. 열 시에 시작해요.

lines.en: I came here twice last winter.
lines.ko: 작년 겨울에 여기 두 번 왔어요.

lines.en: I remember you. Please come whenever you like.
lines.ko: 기억나요. 오고 싶을 때 언제든 오세요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will come next week.
Good. I will keep a book for you.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 책 한 권 남겨 둘게요.
